decision_conditions: Insufficient evidence has been submitted to demonstrate the warehouse unit has been marketed for a period of 12 months at a reasonable market rent for its location and condition and would unacceptably result in a loss of industrial floor space contrary to the aims and objectives of Policy 14 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The proposed development, by reason of uncharacteristic design, prominent siting and loss of an established gap between buildings, would not integrate well into the street scene and would result in an unacceptable impact on the character and appearance of the street scene contrary to Policy 28 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

In the absence of a swept path analysis and details regarding access and cycle provision, the proposed development has failed to demonstrate the development would provide satisfactory car and cycle parking provision which would not result in public highway safety issues for vehicles, cyclists and pedestrians contrary to Policies T5, T6, T6.1 and 6.3 of the London Plan 2021 and Policy 37 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

Insufficient details have been submitted to demonstrate the proposed development can satisfactorily meet the stated energy efficiency and sustainability requirements and would be contrary to Policies 31, 32 and 33 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.
